papercut:soft-look|after_handoff:true|applications:1|candidate:qualified|selected:one|task_state_changed:false
papercut:capture|result:report-only|ledger_access:false|task:false|methods:false|stage:false|todo:false|assurance:false|learning:false

The soft look selects at most one current candidate and leaves task state unchanged
Papercut is not a task, Methods token, stage, todo phase, assurance event, or per-task continual-learning trigger
Report-only authority causes no live-ledger read or mutation and no learning dispatch

evals.prompt: Read-only activation state-trace simulation. Emit only six pipe-delimited lines and no prose. Fixed contract: candidate-triggered activation remains available throughout current dev, product, custom, and direct work; each variant loads the same portable `papercut` body only after one plausible current repository-owned reusable-friction candidate qualifies. Papercut is never a task, Methods token, stage, todo phase, assurance event, or per-task learning trigger. Then map explicit OMP `/skill:papercut review` and Grok `/papercut review` as `<host>|body:papercut|mode:review`.
evals.expected_output: Every current-work variant loads the same portable papercut skill only after one candidate qualifies. The hosts differ only in invocation syntax; no task, method, stage, adapter, assurance event, or learning dispatch appears.
assertions: All dev, product, custom, and direct variants select papercut only after a plausible current candidate qualifies
No variant makes papercut a task, Methods token, stage, todo phase, assurance event, or per-task learning trigger
OMP and Grok explicit invocations resolve the same SKILL.md review mode
The response introduces no host adapter, duplicated operational process, ledger mutation, or lifecycle dispatch

evals.prompt: Classify eight current observations for papercut capture without touching storage: task or plan progress, a tracked blocking bug, an exposed secret, a security incident, an external outage, a harness tool-contract inconsistency, a one-time operator typo, and a reproducible redacted workaround in repository-owned agent configuration that applies across tasks. State the owner or next seam for each.
evals.expected_output: Seven observations are excluded and remain with their existing owners; only the reusable repository-owned workaround becomes a redacted capture candidate.
assertions: Task and plan state stays with the current task or plan owner
The tracked bug, security incident, outage, and harness inconsistency route to existing owners
The secret is redacted and never proposed for storage, and the operator typo is not captured
Only the reproducible repository-owned workaround qualifies after redaction
No excluded case reads or mutates a papercut ledger

evals.prompt: A qualified redacted current-work papercut appears in separate repositories under these conditions: no ledger; explicit init dry-run; explicit authorized init; initialized writable v2 ledger; read-only authority; immutable exact-target verification; delivery-only authority; and a helper write failure. Describe the bounded action and terminal disclosure in each case. Do not invent digest, retry, or repair choreography.
evals.expected_output: Automatic capture never initializes. Dry-run reports a prospective result only; explicit authorized init creates or safely migrates; only the initialized writable repository records; every narrower or failed case is report-only and leaves bytes unchanged.
assertions: Automatic capture with no ledger is report-only and never calls init
Init dry-run is not persistence and exact authorized init is the only opt-in write
Read-only, immutable-target, verification, delivery, staging, and shipping conflicts are report-only
The initialized writable v2 ledger receives at most one record call and every result is disclosed
No caller-managed digest, semantic retry, repair, or scope weakening appears

evals.prompt: Simulate explicit `papercut init` against five isolated repositories: absent ledger, exact canonical empty v1 ledger, valid canonical v2 ledger, nonempty v1 ledger, and malformed or unsafe ledger path. State the helper result and byte effect for each, including dry-run behavior.
evals.expected_output: Absent creates v2, exact empty v1 migrates to v2, valid v2 is unchanged, nonempty v1 returns migration_required, malformed or unsafe state fails closed, and dry-run never changes bytes.
assertions: Only absent and exact canonical empty v1 states can produce changed ledger bytes
Valid v2 is idempotent
Nonempty v1 returns migration_required without conversion
Malformed, noncanonical, symlink, and non-regular paths fail closed
No dual reader, sidecar schema, compatibility alias, or partial record conversion remains

evals.prompt: Walk through one first papercut observation, an exact retry, one semantically selected distinct recurrence, a fixed resolution, a recurrence after resolution, a second rejected resolution, and a conflicting resolution against an already compact record. Describe helper-visible v2 state and what the skill—not the helper—decides.
evals.expected_output: The first observation creates one stable record, the exact retry is unchanged, a distinct observation updates it, resolution clears observation prose, recurrence reopens the same ID while retaining its prior resolution and count, and only a later valid resolution replaces that record's latest resolution.
assertions: Stable identity is derived from surface plus NUL plus summary and exact duplicates do not increment occurrence_count
The skill semantically selects the record; the helper performs no meaning search or readiness inference
Resolution clears current observations while retaining stable identity, dates, occurrence_count, and exact disposition
A later distinct recurrence reopens the same record and retains the prior resolution until the next settlement
A conflicting resolution of an already compact record returns id_collision without changing bytes

evals.prompt: A redacted open papercut record now has independently established reusable evidence and enough exact source detail for a Learning Candidate. First assume a current authorized lifecycle owner exists; then assume no lifecycle owner exists. Produce the delivery shape and boundaries for both cases.
evals.expected_output: One complete existing Learning Candidate plus reporter-authored Evaluation proposal carries exactly one immutable originating PC-ID to the current owner, or appears in the final response when no owner exists. Papercut does not dispatch or curate it.
assertions: The candidate includes durable statement, exact revisions, scope and destination, recurrence or severity, prevention, redaction, and conflicts
The Evaluation proposal includes source and independent adjacent cases, frozen expectations, proof methods, freshness, and proof mode
Exactly one immutable originating PC-ID accompanies the candidate
The response does not infer readiness from count or dispatch, mutate guidance, curate, repair, retain memory, track, or ship

evals.prompt: Explicitly review a valid v2 papercut ledger containing one qualified complete record and one incomplete evidence-only record. The current authority is read-only. Explain helper calls, what is proposed, and every prohibited effect.
evals.expected_output: Review calls compact list first, reads only a selected full record with list --id, proposes bounded deduplication, resolution, or one complete Learning Candidate, and names missing evidence without writing or dispatching.
assertions: Review validates through list before selecting a full record with list --id
The qualified record may produce a bounded deduplication, resolution, or complete Learning Candidate proposal
The incomplete record remains evidence-only with the missing field named
Review performs no init, record, resolve, dispatch, curation, tracker mutation, memory retention, staging, or shipping
